strong_novelty_candidates: TAPE-INT-MULT-CERT-1.0 zero-floating-point exact modular and algebraic verification framework
summary: We evaluate TAPE-INT-MULT-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point verification engine and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel auditing OpenAI's November 24, 2026 unrefereed preprint on the 1/2 logarithmic exponent of integer multiplication on tapes. The work establishes 18 machine-checked Lean theorems and 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16) covering guarded shift XOR, triangular CRT, Bluestein chirp conjugation, Newton/Brent arithmetic, sunflower 3-SAT branching, and Euclidean wire-price bounds with zero sorry and zero custom axioms.
weaknesses: Scope boundary excludes full-scale multitape Turing-machine head trajectory and asymptotic CAT(0) Poincaré proofs end-to-end, relying instead on finite algebraic, modular, and combinatorial certificates.
